info.title: Payment Service API
info.description:
Target v1 contract; NOT implemented HTTP endpoints. See docs/requirements for business rules.
Payment-attempt creation is a Commerce backend-to-Payment call: Commerce owns checkout
validation and the immutable order-price snapshot. See commerce-payment-checkout-contract-v0.1.md.
Commerce service RS256 JWT only (aud=payment-service, 60-second TTL, scope per operation).
PG1=KAKAO and PG2=NAVER are the existing simulators. All transactions are simulated.
Common 400/401/403/429/503 responses follow ErrorResponse. Never expose these internal paths to browsers.

post.summary: Prepare a payment attempt from a Commerce-verified checkout snapshot

201.description: Created or previously created idempotent attempt

post.summary: Approve an attempt through the configured PG

202.description: Attempt pending or UNKNOWN; query this attempt, never initiate another payment on timeout.

get.summary: Query an attempt after a pending or unknown approval result
Query a pending or unknown refund

post.summary: Cancel or void an approved payment when the provider allows it

202.description: Cancellation accepted with an unknown provider result

post.summary: Request a full or partial refund

201.description: Refund completed or previously completed idempotent refund

202.description: Refund accepted but provider result is pending or unknown

post.summary: Receive and deduplicate a PG webhook

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.eventId.rawBody; provider-specific secret; constant-time verification.

parameters.name: X-Provider-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds; absolute clock skew at most 300 seconds.

post.summary: Fence future prepare/approve before Commerce releases stock

200.description: Persistent CLOSED gate and current disposition; only CLOSED_NO_EFFECT permits release.

202.description: Gate closed but a prior financial operation remains in flight.

200.description: Current durable approval, void or refund operation

immutableResult.description: Frozen result at resultVersion, not a join to the latest payment snapshot. Present after a definitive outcome; reconcile using operationId/resultVersion.

bearerAuth.description: RS256 service JWT. Allowlisted Commerce issuer/sub, payment-service audience, 60s expiry and operation-specific scope. No browser bearer tokens.

PgWebhook.description: Verify HMAC on raw bytes before JSON parsing; maximum 256 KiB.

PreparePaymentRequest.description:
Internal Commerce-to-Payment request. The caller must be an authenticated Commerce service;
clients must not submit a price or order reference directly to Payment.

operationId.description: Source operation for this result; reconcile immutable facts via payment-operations.

ProviderError.description: Provider call could not be dispatched. Ambiguous dispatched results must be retained as UNKNOWN and returned via 202, not retried as a new operation.
